Flight recorder export

Copy this and paste it to Claude. Includes runs, tags, notes, active config, and the last bot sim.

Requisition

Medical, ammo, armor and throwables are auto-loaded on your next deployment. Higher reputation (earned by selling and completing contracts) unlocks better stock.

Vesh the Gambler

Something in the pile, same price whatever it is. No refunds, no complaints.

The Terms

Sign for worse conditions and Meridian pays better. Every one of these is a real handicap, it applies the moment you deploy, and the bonus is paid only if you walk out. Die under your own terms and you have simply made a bad day worse.

Season 1

Ten tiers. Every raid feeds it, and a raid you die on still pays half, because a run you learned something from is not worth nothing. Finish the track and the world moves up a tier: loot is worth more and everything out there is harder.

What I am building next

In order. This is the actual queue, not a wish list.

The Hiring Bench

One raider, one run, paid up front. He loots for himself and you take ten percent of what he carries out. If he dies you owe his family, and that is not optional. On the surface, B cycles his orders: loot free, follow you, or hold a position. Stand with him and E searches his bag, and your cut is settled at the ramp either way. If you go down, he comes for you.

Dev tools

Instrumentation, not gameplay. This is where the export, the bot sim, the roadmap and the old builds live. HIS NOTE: "way too much sthit going on in the stash, needs to simplify" - the Operator Terminal was carrying all of this on the same screen as his stash and his loadout, so the panel he opens twenty times a raid to look at loot was two thirds developer furniture.

Where are you going?

Four sectors, and they are not reskins of each other. Your stash, your credits, your contracts and your seal progress are yours everywhere; what changes is the ground you have to work. Your body stays on the sector it fell on.

FIRST TIME OUT

Eight things worth knowing before you take the lift up. You can bring this back any time from Settings.

Settings

Presentation only. Nothing here changes the game, the balance or your profile.

Dev Crate

Testing convenience. Take any of it into the next raid, or take none. Opt in per run.
CRATE · drag right, or click Take
YOUR STASH · drag left to bin

Workshop

Craft from stash materials. Junk becomes components, components become gear.

Tuning console

Live sliders. Items marked NEXT RAID apply on the next deployment. Tune until it feels right, then Copy config and paste it to Claude to make it the new default. Presets: A darker and slower, B baseline, C brighter and faster.
